topics.purpose: After the label-free structural-invariant space is thoroughly closed, find the next genuinely-different non-vacuous direction (a new math<->bio structural pairing OR a precise falsifiable bio-data test).
topics.question: Context (established, do not relitigate): for the genetic code as a partition of the 64-codon Hamming cube Q6, we have now shown it is structurally TYPICAL for EVERY canonical label-free codon-graph invariant beyond the single edge-hiding functional e_in -- fold boundaries, degeneracy/branch splits, quotient equitability, cross-box square 2-face motif residual (p=0.25), external bypass-conductance between disconnected fiber components (p=0.20), and quotient spanning-tree compression (p=0.06) -- all COINCIDENCE under nulls that condition out e_in + box/wobble + edge-margins + boundary-degrees + component structure. The lone certified positive is the contravariant e_in edge-hiding extremality (Window6 separating endpoint vs code tolerant endpoint). Both non-q6 Window6->codon embeddings fail. So the label-free codon-graph structural-invariant space is essentially closed. QUESTION: What is the next GENUINELY-DIFFERENT, non-vacuous direction? Pick the single highest-leverage one of: (A) a DIFFERENT math<->bio structural pairing (a forced/canonical math object other than Window6, mapped non-circularly to a hard enumerable bio structure other than the codon fold -- e.g. RNA secondary-structure arc-diagram combinatorics, tRNA cloverleaf topology, etc.) with a concrete LABEL-FREE invariant + a falsifiable null (NOT a Motzkin/Catalan/Fibonacci recurrence COUNT, which is grammar-equivalence not forcing); OR (B) a precise BIO-DATA test of the e_in edge-hiding extremality's biological consequence (e.g. does the code's near-maximal mistranslation-edge-hiding predict a measurable fidelity/robustness quantity), naming the SPECIFIC public dataset + exact quantity + confound controls + whether realistically fetchable. Give ONE concrete first experiment with its exact statistic and pre-registered null. If you judge the whole math<->bio forcing program is complete, say so with the reason.
